entry.title: Difference bases in dihedral groups
entry.summary: A subset $B$ of a group $G$ is called a difference basis of $G$ if each element $g\in G$ can be written as the difference $g=ab^{-1}$ of some elements $a,b\in B$. The smallest cardinality $|B|$ of a difference basis $B\subset G$ is called the difference size of $G$ and is denoted by $Δ[G]$. The fraction $ð[G]:=Δ[G]/{\sqrt{|G|}}$ is called the difference characteristic of $G$. We prove that for every $n\in\mathbb N$ the dihedral group $D_{2n}$ of order $2n$ has the difference characteristic $\sqrt{2}\leð[D_{2n}]\leq\frac{48}{\sqrt{586}}\approx1.983$. Moreover, if $n\ge 2\cdot 10^{15}$, then $ð[D_{2n}]<\frac{4}{\sqrt{6}}\approx1.633$. Also we calculate the difference sizes and characteristics of all dihedral groups of cardinality $\le80$.

entry.title: Difference bases in cyclic groups
entry.summary: A subset $B$ of an Abelian group $G$ is called a difference basis of $G$ if each element $g\in G$ can be written as the difference $g=a-b$ of some elements $a,b\in B$. The smallest cardinality $|B|$ of a difference basis $B\subset G$ is called the difference size of $G$ and is denoted by $Δ[G]$. We prove that for every $n\in\mathbb N$ the cyclic group $C_n$ of order $n$ has difference size $\frac{1+\sqrt{4|n|-3}}2\le Δ[C_n]\le\frac32\sqrt{n}$. If $n\ge 9$ (and $n\ge 2\cdot 10^{15}$), then $Δ[C_n]\le\frac{12}{\sqrt{73}}\sqrt{n}$ (and $Δ[C_n]<\frac2{\sqrt{3}}\sqrt{n}$). Also we calculate the difference sizes of all cyclic groups of cardinality $\le 100$.

entry.title: Difference bases in finite Abelian groups
entry.summary: A subset $B$ of a group $G$ is called a difference basis of $G$ if each element $g\in G$ can be written as the difference $g=ab^{-1}$ of some elements $a,b\in B$. The smallest cardinality $|B|$ of a difference basis $B\subset G$ is called the difference size of $G$ and is denoted by $Δ[G]$. The fraction $ð[G]:=\frac{Δ[G]}{\sqrt{|G|}}$ is called the difference characteristic of $G$. Using properies of the Galois rings, we prove recursive upper bounds for the difference sizes and characteristics of finite Abelian groups. In particular, we prove that for a prime number $p\ge 11$, any finite Abelian $p$-group $G$ has difference characteristic $ð[G]<\frac{\sqrt{p}-1}{\sqrt{p}-3}\cdot\sup_{k\in\mathbb N}ð[C_{p^k}]<\sqrt{2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{p}-1}{\sqrt{p}-3}$. Also we calculate the difference sizes of all Abelian groups of cardinality $<96$.

entry.title: On certain classes of commutative g-dimonoids
entry.summary: We study g-dimonoids, which are algebraic structures equipped with two associative binary operations satisfying a prescribed system of axioms. We develop a construction of g-dimonoids based on inflations of semigroups, construct several classes of 2-dinilpotent commutative g-dimonoids, and investigate the isomorphism problem for these classes. As an application of these results, we obtain a structural description of all commutative g-dimonoids of order 3, up to isomorphism.
